name: Robotics engineer relocating toward Swiss scaleups

constraints: Wants hands-on robotics work at a scaleup
context.company_awareness: Some Swiss robotics names known; needs to discover the rest

trigger: A prototype programme at the current employer ends, making a Swiss robotics move worth exploring before accepting another maintenance assignment.

searches_run.query: robotics embedded engineer jobs Zurich Lausanne English relocation
searches_run.observation: Results included employer and aggregator listings around Zurich, English-language requirements, and relocation wording on Hexagon listings. Lausanne evidence was thinner in this sample; returned internships and older PDFs were not all level-appropriate.

searches_run.query: Swiss robotics startup engineer jobs travel requirements English
searches_run.observation: Results included explicitly travel-heavy deployment roles and a PREEN engineering role stating up to 30% travel. Product engineering and field deployment can share robotics terminology while implying different working lives.

sources.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer — Hexagon Robotics
sources.supports: Retrieved snippet describes English required, basic German advantageous and relocation support. Not directly inspected or verified as currently available.

sources.title: Machine Design Engineer — PREEN Technologies
sources.supports: Directly inspected employer page states Zurich or remote Europe, up to 30% international travel, fluent English and German as a plus. This is adjacent mechanical work, not proof of a matching embedded vacancy.

sources.title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer - Intern — Flink Robotics
sources.supports: Retrieved ATS snippet specifies fluent English and 50–100% customer-site travel. Its internship level does not fit this persona.

best_entry_page.primary_query: robotics companies in Zurich and Lausanne hiring engineers
best_entry_page.promise: Discover robotics employers by city and follow their relevant openings, with source-backed language and travel details where published.
best_entry_page.cta: Choose employers and save a robotics or embedded search.
proof_needed: Verify actual company coverage and distinguish Lausanne from wider western Switzerland.
Show embedded, controls and deployment roles separately through concrete examples.
Cite role-specific travel requirements; missing travel information must stay unknown.
An indexable guide would be new; company and search pages currently remain noindex.
Do not infer scaleup stage or working language from an English posting alone.

conversion_objections: Will you cover small robotics employers rather than mostly web software companies?
Can you distinguish embedded development from field deployment?
Is the advertised language sufficient for the team?
Can I inspect actual travel requirements before committing to a move?

avoid_targeting.reason: Citizenship is not supplied and legal eligibility is outside this acquisition promise.
Wrong seniority despite frequent retrieval overlap.

avoid_targeting.query: robotics jobs Switzerland no travel guaranteed
avoid_targeting.reason: Descriptions cannot guarantee travel policy or reveal omitted requirements.

message_to_founder: Simulation: I would move for the right robot, but I do not want to spend half the year installing it at customer sites. Help me discover the smaller Swiss teams and show the actual language and travel wording before I subscribe.
confidence_and_limits: Synthetic search journey, not customer testimony. Two retrieval queries and one direct inspection establish examples, not demand, rankings or market coverage. Zurich evidence dominated; no conclusion about relative Lausanne opportunity is justified.

search_journey.fit_reason: Occupation/location search fits but includes many adjacent disciplines.
Role, technology and place align with basic search.
Posting language helps discovery, not workplace-language verification.

search_journey.fit_reason: Several filters fit; relocation remains description evidence.
